newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT-March SQ not likely to affect Japan stocks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-March SQ not likely to affect Japan stocks.

text.p: The settlement of Japan's March stock futures and options, called "special quotations (SQ)", on Friday is not likely to affect cash stocks, traders said on Thursday.
The market is expected to see light net selling related to the settlement, but any dips in cash stocks would be supported by buying from domestic pension funds, they said.
"The SQ is not likely to roil the markets as much as some people think. We expect the Nikkei 225 to see net selling of 500,000 shares," said one trader at a second-tier securities house.
"There will be sales of 1.50 million shares and buying of 1.15 million shares," said another trader.
Traders said the expected net selling is unlikely to trigger a sharp fall in the Nikkei 225 average because the outstanding volume of the futures-linked trade is relatively light.
Many said that even if the Nikkei dips unexpectedly, strong buying demand by domestic pension funds is likely to underpin the index at around 18,000.
